description: This file defines the NavigationClickListener interface, which declares two methods for handling click events on navigation items and icons within the application's navigation component.

classes.name: NavigationClickListener
classes.description: An interface for listening to navigation item and icon click events.

methods.name: onItemClick
methods.description: Callback triggered upon clicking a navigation item.

methods.name: onIconClick
methods.description: Callback triggered upon clicking a navigation icon.
